Advanced Rehabilitation Research Training Program
summary: The Advanced Rehabilitation Research Training Program provides advanced research training and experience to individuals with doctorates or similar advanced degrees. Projects must enhance the capacity of researchers to conduct high-quality multidisciplinary disability and rehabilitation research focused on community living and participation outcomes among people with disabilities. Eligible applicants are public, state-controlled, and private institutions of higher education.
italy_evidence: Foreign entities are not eligible to compete for, or receive, awards made under this announcement.

Advanced Rehabilitation Research Training in Health and Function
summary: The Advanced Rehabilitation Research Training Program funded by NIDILRR provides advanced multidisciplinary research training and experience to individuals holding doctorates or similar advanced degrees. The call aims to enhance the capacity of rehabilitation researchers, including those with disabilities, to conduct high-quality research focused on health and function outcomes. Eligible applicants are limited to public, state-controlled, and private institutions of higher education based in the United States.
